program:
app "Cards" cards slate
table point team pick Us|Them, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Us)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Them)
setting winat num = 100 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Us" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Us, pts = 1
  stack card grow align center
    "Them" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Them, pts = 1
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
if a >= winat
  "Us win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Them win!" head color good
list point
describe:
Cards, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Us, Them; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 100.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Us.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Them.
Shows:
- text: "Us".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Us, pts set to 1.
- text: "Them".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Them, pts set to 1.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Us win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Them win!".
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

fuller_style: one long sentence of 18 to 30 words

program:
app "Fridge" milk ocean
table food_item name text, qty num 0.., low num 0.. = 3, price money?, kind pick Dry|Fresh|Frozen, expires date?
state q text = ""
let short = count(food_item, it.qty <= it.low)
short "food running low" head color if(short > 0, warn, good)
field q "Search"
each food_item where has(name, q) sort qty as i
  row card gap 1 tap edit i swipe remove i
    stack grow
      i.name bold color if(i.qty <= i.low, warn, ink)
      i.kind faint
      "Expires" i.expires faint color if(i.expires < today, bad, muted)
    button "-" tap set i.qty = i.qty - 1
    i.qty bold
    button "+" tap set i.qty = i.qty + 1
"Stock value" sum(food_item, it.qty * it.price) faint
form food_item
remind "Check your food" at 9:00 on sat
describe:
Fridge, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- food item: name: text; qty: number, at least 0; low: number, at least 0, starts at 3; price: money, optional; kind: one of Dry, Fresh, Frozen; expires: date, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- short is how many of the food item have its qty is at most its low.
Remembers while you use it: q, starting at "".
Shows:
- text: short, "food running low".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Search".
- for each food item where name contains q sorted by qty:
  - a group; a tap opens the food item for editing; a swipe removes the food item, with undo:
    - text: the name of the food item.
    - text: the kind of the food item.
    - text: "Expires", the expires of the food item.
    - a button "-"; a tap sets the qty of the food item to the qty of the food item minus 1.
    - text: the qty of the food item.
    - a button "+"; a tap sets the qty of the food item to the qty of the food item plus 1.
- text: "Stock value", the sum of its qty times its price over the food item.
- a form to add a food item.
Reminder "Check your food" at 9:00 on Sat.

fuller_style: one sentence of 14 to 22 words, mentions the most special feature first

program:
app "Shopping" bag ink
table purchase what text, amount money, category pick Clothes|Shoes|Gadgets|Beauty|Gifts
let spent = sum(purchase.amount month)
setting budget money = 20000 "Monthly budget"
"Last month" sum(purchase.amount prev month) faint
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form purchase
share purchase month by category, sum(it.amount), it.key
list purchase month by day
describe:
Shopping, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- purchase: what: text; amount: money; category: one of Clothes, Shoes, Gadgets, Beauty, Gifts. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 20000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of purchase this month.
Shows:
- text: "Last month", the total amount of purchase last month.
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a purchase.
- bars that compare the total amount of the item across group of purchase entries this month by category.
- a list of purchase this month by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

app "Zikr" beads slate
table zikr
setting target num = 100
let n = count(zikr today)
draw width 240 tap add zikr
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * clamp(n / target, 0, 1) stroke accent thick 8
  label 50, 46, n big
  label 50, 64, "of" target faint
button "Reset today" tap remove all zikr today
button "Undo" tap remove last(zikr today)
stat count(zikr), "all time"
daybars last 7 days, count(zikr on it)
when n = target notify "Target reached"
describe:

program:
app "Table tennis" ball plum
table point team pick Home|Away, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Home)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Away)
setting winat num = 11 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Home" bold
    a big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Home, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+5" tap add point team = Home, pts = 5
  stack card grow align center
    "Away" bold
    b big
    button "+1" tap add point team = Away, pts = 1
    row gap 1
      button "+5" tap add point team = Away, pts = 5
button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point
if a >= winat
  "Home win!" head color good
if b >= winat
  "Away win!" head color good
"Lead:" abs(a - b) faint
list point
describe:
Table tennis, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- point: team: one of Home, Away; pts: number, 1 to 500, starts at 1. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Play to": number, starts at 11.
Works out:
- a is the total pts of point where team is Home.
- b is the total pts of point where team is Away.
Shows:
- text: "Home".
- text: a.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Home, pts set to 1.
- a button "+5"; a tap adds a point with team set to Home, pts set to 5.
- text: "Away".
- text: b.
- a button "+1"; a tap adds a point with team set to Away, pts set to 1.
- a button "+5"; a tap adds a point with team set to Away, pts set to 5.
- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- if a is at least winat:
  - text: "Home win!".
- if b is at least winat:
  - text: "Away win!".
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.
- a list of point; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
